description_en: Queries the specifications of a specified Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 查询指定的DDoS原生防护实例的规格信息
name: DescribeInstanceSpecs

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query. The value is a JSON array converted to a string. Each element in the JSON array represents an instance ID in string format. Multiple IDs are separated by commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances in a specified region
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素表示一个实例ID（字符串格式），多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询指定地域下所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Default value: cn-hangzhou, which indicates the China (Hangzhou) region.

If your instance is not in the China (Hangzhou) region, you must specify the region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query all region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例的地域ID。默认为cn-hangzhou，表示华东1（杭州）。

如果您的实例不在华东1（杭州）地域，则此处必须填写实例所在地域的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询所有的**RegionId**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. Default value: empty, which indicates the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

InstanceSpecs.description_en: The specification information of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance, including the enabling status of best-effort protection, and the available and used best-effort protection times
InstanceSpecs.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的规格信息，包含全力防护的开启状态、可用和已用的全力防护次数等

items.description_en: The specification information of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
items.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的规格信息

AvailableDefenseTimes.description_zh: 当前可用的全力防护次数

AvailableDeleteBlackholeCount.description_en: The available quota for deactivating blackhole filtering
AvailableDeleteBlackholeCount.description_zh: 当前可用的解除黑洞次数

DefenseTimesPercent.description_en: The usage percentage of best-effort protection times. Unit: %
DefenseTimesPercent.description_zh: 全力防护次数使用的百分比。单位：百分比

DowngradeStatus.description_en:
The downgrade status of the instance. Valid values:

8: The instance is downgraded because the clean bandwidth exceeds the limit
DowngradeStatus.description_zh:
实例的降级状态。取值：

8：实例因为业务带宽超用被降级

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance

IsFullDefenseMode.description_en:
Indicates whether best-effort protection mode is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

0: Best-effort protection mode is disabled.
1: Best-effort protection mode is enabled
IsFullDefenseMode.description_zh:
该实例是否开启了全力防护模式。取值：

0：未开启全力防护模式。
1：开启了全力防护模式

PackConfig.description_en: The configuration information of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance, including the number of protected IP addresses and protection bandwidth information
PackConfig.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的配置信息，包含防护IP数量、防护带宽信息等

BindIpCount.description_en: The number of protected IP addresses

ElasticBwMbps.description_en: The burstable clean bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s

ElasticBwMode.description_en:
The burstable clean bandwidth mode. Valid values:

month: Monthly 95th percentile metering method.
day: Daily 95th percentile metering method
ElasticBwMode.description_zh:
弹性业务带宽模式。取值：

month：月95弹性模式。
day：日95弹性模式

IpAdvanceThre.description_en: The burstable protection threshold for the protected IP address. Unit: Gbit/s
IpAdvanceThre.description_zh: 被防护IP的弹性防护阈值。单位：Gbps

IpBasicThre.description_en: The basic protection threshold for the protected IP address. Unit: Gbit/s
IpBasicThre.description_zh: 被防护IP的基础防护阈值。单位：Gbps

IpSpec.description_en: The number of IP addresses that can be added for protection

NormalBandwidth.description_en: The normal clean bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s

PackAdvThre.description_en: The burstable protection bandwidth of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Unit: Gbit/s
PackAdvThre.description_zh: 原生防护实例的弹性防护带宽。单位：Gbps

PackBasicThre.description_en: The basic protection bandwidth of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Unit: Gbit/s
PackBasicThre.description_zh: 原生防护实例的基础防护带宽。单位：Gbps

Region.description_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html） operation to query the details of region IDs
Region.description_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例的地域ID。

您可以调用[DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html）查询地域ID的具体含义

TotalDefenseTimes.description_en: The total available best-effort protection times
TotalDefenseTimes.description_zh: 总共可用的全力防护次数
